integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible finite standard-library tests; no assertion that numeric quadrature proves universal statements. Earlier symmetric dual Minkowski existence/uniqueness criteria are credited. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Complete image for positive even four-atom coordinate-normal data among origin-interior planar convex bodies; full fiber classification for q>=1; only centered-rectangle inverse and existence of some off-center competing solutions proved for 0<q<1. Historical priority provisional; independent validation not performed.
title: A sharp four-atom dual Minkowski inverse and symmetry-breaking threshold
